%% Regex Torture Test
%% Each entry below is a minimal, non-failing LaTeX snippet that exercises
%% an edge case previously caught by a bug report.  The test suite compiles
%% the full file to verify that no regex change breaks these constructs.

\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\usepackage{xcolor}

%% From BUG-24: \definecolor and \colorlet must survive build_minimal_preamble
\definecolor{darkgreen}{rgb}{0,0.5,0}
\colorlet{myblue}{blue}

%% From BUG-23: \newtheorem print-name with nested braces (\ref{...})
\newtheorem*{def31}{Definition \ref{def:afb}}

\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}

%% From BUG-25: \newtheorem that would conflict with class-predefined environments
%% The pipeline wraps these in \@ifundefined guards; the regex must still match them.
\newtheorem{lemma}{Lemma}[section]
\newtheorem*{remark}{Remark}

%% From BUG-29: multiple \newenvironment defs must each keep their own begin/end code
%% (closure capture bug: all lambdas must bind begin/end by value, not by reference)
\newenvironment{mydefn}{\begin{theorem}}{\end{theorem}}
\newenvironment{myremark}{\begin{theorem}}{\end{theorem}}

\begin{document}

\begin{theorem}
Hello.
\end{theorem}

\begin{mydefn}
A definition.
\end{mydefn}

\begin{myremark}
A remark.
\end{myremark}

\end{document}
